foggy: It was so foggy this morning that we could hardly see the road ahead.
今天早上雾很大，我们几乎看不清前面的路。
goalkeeper: The goalkeeper jumped high and caught the ball before anyone could reach it.
守门员高高跃起，在别人碰到球之前把球接住了。
hooray: When the teacher announced a day off, all the students shouted, "Hooray!"
当老师宣布放假一天时，所有学生都大喊："好哇！"
mango: This mango is so sweet that I want to buy another one for my sister.
这个芒果太甜了，我想再给妹妹买一个。
miow: I heard a soft "miow" outside the door and found a hungry little cat.
我听到门外传来轻轻的"喵"声，发现了一只饥饿的小猫。
Parrot: The green Parrot can say a few simple words, such as hello and goodbye.
这只绿色的鹦鹉会说几个简单的词，比如你好和再见。
PopaWestray: PopaWestray is a small island where visitors can watch thousands of seabirds in summer.
帕帕韦斯特雷岛是一个小岛，夏天游客可以在那里观赏成千上万的海鸟。
phew: Phew, I finally finished all my homework before ten o'clock tonight.
唷，今晚我终于在十点前做完了全部作业。
spicy: The soup is a little too spicy for me, so I added some water to it.
这汤对我来说有点太辣了，所以我加了一些水。
swan: A white swan was moving quietly across the calm lake at sunrise.
日出时分，一只白天鹅静静地滑过平静的湖面。
tick-tock: I could not fall asleep because of the tick-tock of the old clock in the hall.
大厅里老式时钟的滴答声让我无法入睡。
urgh: Urgh, this milk smells terrible — it must have gone bad days ago.
呃，这牛奶闻起来很难闻，肯定几天前就变质了。
swoosh: The ball flew past my ear with a swoosh and landed in the basket.
球嗖的一声从我耳边飞过，落进了篮筐。
go by: Most people here go by their first names, even at work.
这里的大多数人相互称呼名字，即使在工作时也是如此。
be full of: Her school bag is full of books, pens, and a small dictionary.
她的书包里满是书、钢笔和一本小词典。
The firefighters are always ready to help people in danger at any time.
消防员们随时都愿意帮助处于危险中的人。
looks: He is a kind boy, and his looks remind me of his elder brother.
他是个善良的男孩，他的容貌让我想起他的哥哥。
good luck: Good luck in the exam tomorrow — I believe you will do well.
祝你明天考试好运，我相信你会考得很好。
Chinese chess: My grandfather often plays Chinese chess with his friends in the park.
我爷爷经常和朋友们在公园里下中国象棋。
at the weekend: We usually go swimming or ride bikes at the weekend.
我们周末通常去游泳或骑自行车。
make friends with: It is easy to make friends with her because she is friendly and honest.
和她交朋友很容易，因为她友好又诚实。
jogging: My father goes jogging along the river for half an hour every morning.
我爸爸每天早上沿河边慢跑半个小时。
paper-cutting: Paper-cutting is a traditional Chinese art that many old people still enjoy.
剪纸是一门传统的中国艺术，许多老人仍然喜欢它。
take ... apart: My brother likes to take old radios apart to see how they work.
我哥哥喜欢把旧收音机拆开，看看它们是怎么工作的。
role model: Our English teacher is a role model for us because she works hard and never gives up.
我们的英语老师是我们的榜样，因为她努力工作、永不放弃。
sports field: All the students gathered on the sports field for the opening ceremony.
所有学生都聚集在运动场上参加开幕式。
dining: The new school building has a large dining hall with over five hundred seats.
新教学楼有一个可容纳五百多人的大食堂。
noticeboard: Please check the noticeboard near the library to see if your name is on the list.
请查看图书馆旁边的布告板，看看你的名字是否在名单上。
form teacher: Our form teacher often talks with us about our study and life at school.
我们的班主任经常和我们谈论我们在学校的学习和生活。
on weekdays: The shop opens at eight in the morning on weekdays but later on Saturdays.
这家店工作日早上八点开门，周六则晚一些。
field trip: Our class will go on a field trip to the science museum next Friday.
下周五我们班要去科学博物馆进行实地考察。
leave for: We will leave for Beijing early tomorrow morning to visit the Great Wall.
我们明天一早动身去北京参观长城。
roller skate: Learning to roller skate was hard at first, but now I can move quite fast.
学滑旱冰一开始很难，但现在我能滑得相当快了。
tiring: Climbing the mountain was tiring, but the view from the top was worth it.
爬山很累人，但山顶的风景值得。
teeth: You should brush your teeth twice a day to keep them healthy and strong.
你应该每天刷两次牙，保持牙齿健康强壮。
homebody: My sister is a real homebody who would rather read at home than go out.
我姐姐是个真正的宅女，她宁愿在家看书也不愿出门。
have a sweet tooth: I have a sweet tooth, so I always keep some chocolate in my desk.
我爱吃甜食，所以书桌里总是备着一些巧克力。
stay up: Don't stay up too late tonight, or you will feel sleepy in class tomorrow.
今晚不要熬夜太晚，否则明天上课你会犯困。
carton: He drank the last carton of milk and threw the empty box into the bin.
他喝完了最后一盒牛奶，把空盒子扔进了垃圾桶。
smartphone: Spending too much time on your smartphone is bad for both your eyes and your study.
花太多时间在智能手机上对你的眼睛和学习都不好。
